detections.title: Integration platform cold bootstrap (process recycle)
detections.evidence: Cold integrations bootstrap=177.61ms vs warm=0ms. Production reuses process singleton + shared registered platform; cold delta is first-process bootstrap only.
detections.recommendation: Keep getIntegrationManagement singleton; share getOrCreateRegisteredIntegrationPlatform with org-platform.

detections.title: Large application route surface
detections.evidence: 301 app route files detected. Large route graphs increase build time and navigation complexity.
detections.recommendation: Treat performance as a first-class feature; lazy-load rarely used dashboards; keep ECC routes lean.

detections.title: Large client components under Executive Command Center
detections.evidence: 7 client components in components/exec (Opportunity/Wisdom/Integrations pages are full client trees).
detections.recommendation: Convert filter/tab shells to small client islands; keep page bodies as Server Components.

detections.title: Sequential intelligence domain builds on Home/Brief
detections.evidence: loadExecHome builds oios → wisdom → opportunity. Opportunity does not depend on oios; sequential awaits add latency.
detections.recommendation: Promise.all independent builds (oios + opportunity), then wisdom with oiosResult.

detections.title: Exec layout identity resolution waterfall
detections.evidence: exec/layout awaits getAuthUser+getSessionUser, then getIdentityContext (extra Supabase queries), then org platform resolution before children render.
detections.recommendation: Keep parallel auth where possible; cache identity; measure org resolution separately (see probe orgResolutionMs).

detections.title: Middleware authenticates; RSC authorizes (P002)
detections.evidence: Edge middleware verifies session only; catalog authorization runs once via getIdentityContext / requireAuthorizedRoute in layouts.
detections.recommendation: Keep request-scoped caches warm; do not reintroduce loadAuthzSnapshot in middleware.
